items.html: And know that these seven kings are ten, except that they are like the seven Heichalot [chambers], which are ten and are called by the name seven. For the upper Heichal includes the three first Heichalot, and the lower Heichal includes the two last Heichalot. And so it is exactly with these seven kings, for they are ten and are called by the name seven alone. And since these kings are discernments of judgments and Gevurot, it turns out that they are all in the secret of the female, as is known, for the female is entirely judgment.
